title: Confinement effects for semilinear fractional Hermite heat equations with nonlinearities of arbitrarily rapid growth
summary: We study the Cauchy problem for a semilinear heat equation driven by the fractional harmonic oscillator. We establish local and global well-posedness in Orlicz and Morse--Transue spaces, based on sharp semigroup estimates and an integral compatibility condition between the Young function and the nonlinearity. We identify a critical Young function separating local well-posedness from instantaneous nonexistence for suitable data.
